name: RDAP (domain registration data via rdap.org bootstrap)
summary: Modern JSON replacement for WHOIS: domain, IP and ASN registration data.
description: rdap.org redirects queries to the authoritative RDAP server for the TLD or RIR (IANA bootstrap). Returns status, nameservers, registrar entities, events (registration/expiry) in RFC 9083 JSON. Also /ip/{addr} and /autnum/{n}.

rate_limit.summary: Varies by registry; rdap.org is best-effort redirect

agent_notes: rdap.org answers with a 302 redirect to the authoritative registry, so follow redirects (curl -L). Rate limits differ per registry and some TLDs have no RDAP service.
caveats: Response is 302 redirect to the registry; use -L. Registries rate limit differently; some TLDs lack RDAP.
